# 206 — Full iso-recursive types with subtyping: type safety

## Task

Show that a step preserves typing and that a closed well-typed term is a value or can step in the calculus with explicit casts and iso-recursive subtyping.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
=== Makefile ===

LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

=== syntax_ott first 100 ===
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition typevar : Set := var.

Definition termvar : Set := var.

Definition castvar : Set := var.

Definition label : Set := nat.

Definition int : Set := nat.

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | t_var_b : nat -> typ
 | t_var_f : typevar -> typ
 | t_int : typ
 | t_top : typ
 | t_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
 | t_mu : typ -> typ  .

Inductive castop : Set :=
 | c_var_b : nat -> castop
 | c_var_f : castvar -> castop
 | c_id : castop
 | c_unfold : typ -> castop
 | c_fold : typ -> castop
 | c_arrow : castop -> castop -> castop
 | c_seq : castop -> castop -> castop
 | c_fixc : castop -> castop  .

Definition ctx : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | e_var_b : nat -> exp
 | e_var_f : termvar -> exp
 | e_lit : int -> exp
 | e_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
 | e_app : exp -> exp -> exp
 | e_cast : castop -> exp -> exp.

Definition acctx : Set := list (atom * atom).

Definition tctx : Set := list ( atom * unit ).

Definition actx : Set := list ((typ * typ)).

Definition cctx : Set := list ( atom * (typ * typ)).

Fixpoint open_typ_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:typ) (A_6:typ) {struct A_6}: typ :=
  match A_6 with
  | (t_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => t_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => A5
        | inright _ => t_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (t_var_f X) => t_var_f X
  | t_int => t_int
  | t_top => t_top
  | (t_arrow A B) => t_arrow (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A) (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 B)
  | (t_mu A) => t_mu (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec (S k) A5 A)
end.

Fixpoint open_castop_wrt_castop_rec (k:nat) (c_5:castop) (c__6:castop) {struct c__6}: castop :=
  match c__6 with
  | (c_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => c_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => c_5
        | inright _ => c_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold A
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold A
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec (S k) c_5 c)
end.

Fixpoint open_castop_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:typ) (c_5:castop) {struct c_5}: castop :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c)
end.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => e_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => e_5
        | inright _ => e_var_b (nat - 1)
      end

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export LibTactics.

Require Import Lia.

Require Export erasure.

Inductive eqe : tctx -> actx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | e_assump : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A B:typ),
      In ( A ,  B )  H  ->
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     eqe D H A B
 | e_refl : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     eqe D H A A
 | e_trans : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A C B:typ),
     eqe D H A B ->
     eqe D H B C ->
     eqe D H A C
 | e_fld : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
     eqe D H (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )
 | e_unfld : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
     eqe D H  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (t_mu A)
 | e_arrfix : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     eqe D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A1 B1 ->
     eqe D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A2 B2 ->
     eqe D H (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2).

Notation unfold_mu t :=
    (open_typ_wrt_typ t (t_mu t)).

Definition cctx_sem (cl : actx) (Rel: typ -> typ -> Prop) : Type :=
  Forall (fun l => match l with ( A, B) => Rel A B end) cl.

Definition reverse_E (E: cctx) :=
  map (fun v => match v with (A, B) =>  (B, A) end) E.

Definition reverse_A (E: actx) :=
  List.map (fun v => match v with (A, B) =>  (B, A) end) E.

Inductive eq_env: list (typ * typ) -> list (typ * typ) -> Prop :=
| eq_env_nil: eq_env nil nil
| eq_env_cons_same: forall t1 t2 E1 E2,
    eq_env E1 E2 ->
    eq_env ((t1,t2)::E1) ((t1,t2)::E2)
| eq_env_cons_rev: forall t1 t2 E1 E2,
    eq_env E1 E2 ->
    eq_env ((t1,t2)::E1) ((t2,t1)::E2)
.

Definition to_assump (E: cctx) :=
  List.map (fun cx_v => match cx_v with (_, v) => v end) E.

Inductive lc_typ : typ -> Prop :=
 | lc_t_var_f : forall (X:typevar),
     (lc_typ (t_var_f X))
 | lc_t_int :
     (lc_typ t_int)
 | lc_t_top :
     (lc_typ t_top)
 | lc_t_arrow : forall (A B:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_typ B) ->
     (lc_typ (t_arrow A B))
 | lc_t_mu : forall (A:typ),
      ( forall X , lc_typ  ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  ->
     (lc_typ (t_mu A)).

Inductive lc_castop : castop -> Prop :=
 | lc_c_var_f : forall (cx:castvar),
     (lc_castop (c_var_f cx))
 | lc_c_id :
     (lc_castop c_id)
 | lc_c_unfold : forall (A:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_castop (c_unfold A))
 | lc_c_fold : forall (A:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_castop (c_fold A))
 | lc_c_arrow : forall (c1 c2:castop),
     (lc_castop c1) ->
     (lc_castop c2) ->
     (lc_castop (c_arrow c1 c2))
 | lc_c_seq : forall (c1 c2:castop),
     (lc_castop c1) ->
     (lc_castop c2) ->
     (lc_castop (c_seq c1 c2))
 | lc_c_fixc : forall (c:castop),
      ( forall cx , lc_castop  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
     (lc_castop (c_fixc c)).

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_e_var_f : forall (x:termvar),
     (lc_exp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_lit : forall (i:int),
     (lc_exp (e_lit i))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     (lc_typ A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_abs A e))
 | lc_e_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_app e1 e2))
 | lc_e_cast : forall (c:castop) (e:exp),
     (lc_castop c) ->
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (e_cast c e)).

Fixpoint typefv_typ (A5:typ) : vars :=
  match A5 with
  | (t_var_b nat) => {}
  | (t_var_f X) => {{X}}
  | t_int => {}
  | t_top => {}
  | (t_arrow A B) => (typefv_typ A) \u (typefv_typ B)
  | (t_mu A) => (typefv_typ A)
end.

Fixpoint castfv_castop (c_5:castop) : vars :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => {}
  | (c_var_f cx) => {{cx}}
  | c_id => {}
  | (c_unfold A) => {}
  | (c_fold A) => {}
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => (castfv_castop c1) \u (castfv_castop c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => (castfv_castop c1) \u (castfv_castop c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => (castfv_castop c)
end.

Fixpoint typefv_castop (c_5:castop) : vars :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => {}
  | (c_var_f cx) => {}
  | c_id => {}
  | (c_unfold A) => (typefv_typ A)
  | (c_fold A) => (typefv_typ A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => (typefv_castop c1) \u (typefv_castop c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => (typefv_castop c1) \u (typefv_castop c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => (typefv_castop c)
end.

Fixpoint termfv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (termfv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (termfv_exp e1) \u (termfv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (termfv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint castfv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (castfv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (castfv_exp e1) \u (castfv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (castfv_castop c) \u (castfv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint typefv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (typefv_typ A) \u (typefv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (typefv_exp e1) \u (typefv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (typefv_castop c) \u (typefv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint typsubst_typ (A5:typ) (X5:typevar) (A_6:typ) {struct A_6} : typ :=
  match A_6 with
  | (t_var_b nat) => t_var_b nat
  | (t_var_f X) => (if eq_var X X5 then A5 else (t_var_f X))
  | t_int => t_int
  | t_top => t_top
  | (t_arrow A B) => t_arrow (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A) (typsubst_typ A5 X5 B)
  | (t_mu A) => t_mu (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A)
end.

Fixpoint castsubst_castop (c_5:castop) (cx5:castvar) (c__6:castop) {struct c__6} : castop :=
  match c__6 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => (if eq_var cx cx5 then c_5 else (c_var_f cx))
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold A
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold A
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c1) (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c1) (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c)
end.

Fixpoint typsubst_castop (A5:typ) (X5:typevar) (c_5:castop) {struct c_5} : castop :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A)
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c1) (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c1) (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c)
end.

Fixpoint subst_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:termvar) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then e_5 else (e_var_f x))
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (subst_exp e_5 x5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast c (subst_exp e_5 x5 e)
end.

Fixpoint castsubst_exp (c5:castop) (cx5:castvar) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5} : exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e1) (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (castsubst_castop c5 cx5 c) (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e)
end.

Fixpoint typsubst_exp (A5:typ) (X5:typevar) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5} : exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A) (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e1) (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c) (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e)
end.

Fixpoint rev_cast (c:castop) :=
  match c with
  | c_id => c_id
  | c_arrow c1 c2 => c_arrow (rev_cast c1) (rev_cast c2)
  | c_fixc c => c_fixc (rev_cast c)
  | c_unfold t => c_fold t
  | c_fold t => c_unfold t
  | c_seq c1 c2 => c_seq (rev_cast c2) (rev_cast c1)
  | c_var_f x => c_var_f x
  | c_var_b x => c_var_b x
  end.

Fixpoint domA (E : list (atom * atom)) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (X,Y)::E' => singleton X \u singleton Y \u domA E'
  end.

Notation unfold_mu t :=
    (open_typ_wrt_typ t (t_mu t)).

Inductive WFT : tctx -> typ -> Prop :=
 | WFT_top : forall (D:tctx),
     WFT D t_top
 | WFT_int : forall (D:tctx),
     WFT D t_int
 | WFT_var : forall (D:tctx) (X:typevar),
      X  `in` (dom  D )  ->
     WFT D (t_var_f X)
 | WFT_arrow : forall (D:tctx) (A B:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     WFT D (t_arrow A B)
 | WFT_rec : forall (L:vars) (D:tctx) (A:typ),
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> WFT  (cons ( X ,tt )  D )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  ->
     WFT D (t_mu A).

Inductive WFTyE : tctx -> Prop :=
 | WFTyE_empty :
     WFTyE  nil
 | WFTyE_cons : forall (D:tctx) (X:typevar),
     WFTyE D ->
      X  `notin` (dom  D )  ->
     WFTyE  (cons ( X ,tt )  D ) .

Inductive TypCast : tctx -> cctx -> typ -> typ -> castop -> Prop :=
 | TCast_id : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E A A c_id
 | TCast_arrow : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A1 B1 A2 B2:typ) (c1 c2:castop),
     TypCast D E A1 A2 c1 ->
     TypCast D E B1 B2 c2 ->
     TypCast D E (t_arrow A1 B1) (t_arrow A2 B2) (c_arrow c1 c2)
 | TCast_unfold : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (c_unfold (t_mu A))
 | TCast_fold : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (t_mu A) (c_fold (t_mu A))
 | TCast_seq : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A C:typ) (c1 c2:castop) (B:typ),
     TypCast D E A B c1 ->
     TypCast D E B C c2 ->
     TypCast D E A C (c_seq c1 c2)
 | TCast_var : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A B:typ) (cx:castvar),
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
      uniq  E  ->
      In ( cx , ( A ,  B ))  E  ->
     TypCast D E A B (c_var_f cx)
 | TCast_fix : forall (L:vars) (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A1 B1 A2 B2:typ) (c1 c2:castop),
      ( forall cx , cx \notin  L  -> TypCast D  (cons ( cx , ( (t_arrow A1 B1) ,  (t_arrow A2 B2) ))  E )  A1 A2  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c1 (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
      ( forall cx , cx \notin  L  -> TypCast D  (cons ( cx , ( (t_arrow A1 B1) ,  (t_arrow A2 B2) ))  E )  B1 B2  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c2 (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
     TypCast D E (t_arrow A1 B1) (t_arrow A2 B2) (c_fixc  (c_arrow c1 c2) ).

Inductive WFTmE : ctx -> Prop :=
 | WFTmE_empty :
     WFTmE  nil
 | WFTmE_cons : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
     WFT  nil  A ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  G )  ->
     WFTmE  (cons ( x , A )  G ) .

Inductive AmberWF : acctx -> Prop :=
 | AWF_nil :
     AmberWF  nil
 | AWF_cons : forall (AE:acctx) (X Y:typevar),
     AmberWF AE ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  X  (domA  AE )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  Y  (domA  AE )  ->
      X  <>  Y  ->
     AmberWF  (cons ( X , Y  )  AE ) .

Inductive AmberWFT : acctx -> typ -> Prop :=
 | AWFT_nat : forall (AE:acctx),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberWFT AE t_int
 | AWFT_top : forall (AE:acctx),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberWFT AE t_top
 | AWFT_varl : forall (AE:acctx) (X Y:typevar),
     AmberWF AE ->
      In ( X ,  Y )  AE  ->
     AmberWFT AE (t_var_f X)
 | AWFT_varr : forall (AE:acctx) (Y X:typevar),
     AmberWF AE ->
      In ( X ,  Y )  AE  ->
     AmberWFT AE (t_var_f Y)
 | AWFT_arrow : forall (AE:acctx) (A1 A2:typ),
     AmberWFT AE A1 ->
     AmberWFT AE A2 ->
     AmberWFT AE (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | AWFT_rec : forall (L:vars) (AE:acctx) (A:typ) (Y:typevar),
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  ->

          (forall Y, Y `notin` L \u singleton X ->
            AmberWFT (cons ( X ,  Y )  AE  )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  )  ->
     AmberWFT AE (t_mu A).

Inductive AmberSubtyping : acctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | ASub_nat : forall (AE:acctx),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberSubtyping AE t_int t_int
 | ASub_top : forall (AE:acctx) (A:typ),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberWFT AE A ->
     AmberSubtyping AE A t_top
 | ASub_arrow : forall (AE:acctx) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     AmberSubtyping AE B1 A1 ->
     AmberSubtyping AE A2 B2 ->
     AmberSubtyping AE (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | ASub_var : forall (AE:acctx) (X Y:typevar),
     AmberWF AE ->
      In ( X ,  Y )  AE  ->
     AmberSubtyping AE (t_var_f X) (t_var_f Y)
 | ASub_rec : forall (L:vars) (AE:acctx) (A B:typ),
      ( forall Y , Y \notin  L  ->  ( forall X , X \notin   L  \u {{ Y }}  -> AmberSubtyping  (cons ( X , Y  )  AE )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ B (t_var_f Y) )  )  )  ->
     AmberSubtyping AE (t_mu A) (t_mu B)
 | ASub_self : forall (AE:acctx) (A:typ),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberWFT AE (t_mu A) ->
     AmberSubtyping AE (t_mu A) (t_mu A).

Inductive Typing : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | Typing_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     Typing G (e_lit i) t_int
 | Typing_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     Typing G (e_var_f x) A
 | Typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A1:typ) (e:exp) (A2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (cons ( x , A1 )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A2 )  ->
     Typing G (e_abs A1 e) (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | Typing_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A2 A1:typ),
     Typing G e1 (t_arrow A1 A2) ->
     Typing G e2 A1 ->
     Typing G (e_app e1 e2) A2
 | Typing_cast : forall (G:ctx) (c:castop) (e:exp) (B A:typ),
     Typing G e A ->
     TypCast  nil   nil  A B c ->
     Typing G (e_cast c e) B
 | Typing_sub : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (B A:typ),
     Typing G e A ->
     AmberSubtyping  nil  A B ->
     Typing G e B.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | V_lit : forall (i:int),
     value (e_lit i)
 | V_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_exp (e_abs A e) ->
     value  ( (e_abs A e) )
 | V_fold : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     value e ->
     value  ( (e_cast (c_fold A) e) )
 | V_arrow : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop c1 ->
     lc_castop c2 ->
     value e ->
     value  ( (e_cast (c_arrow c1 c2) e) ) .

Inductive Reduction : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | Red_beta : forall (A:typ) (e e':exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_exp (e_abs A e) ->
     value e' ->
     Reduction (e_app  ( (e_abs A e) )  e')  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e e' )
 | Red_appl : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     Reduction e1 e1' ->
     Reduction (e_app e1 e2) (e_app e1' e2)
 | Red_appr : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     Reduction e2 e2' ->
     Reduction (e_app v1 e2) (e_app v1 e2')
 | Red_cast_arr : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e1 e2:exp),
     lc_castop c2 ->
     lc_castop c1 ->
     value e1 ->
     value e2 ->
     Reduction (e_app  ( (e_cast (c_arrow c1 c2) e1) )  e2) (e_cast c2  ( (e_app e1  ( (e_cast  (rev_cast  c1 )  e2) ) ) ) )
 | Red_cast_seq : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop c2 ->
     lc_castop c1 ->
     value e ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_seq c1 c2) e) (e_cast c2  ( (e_cast c1 e) ) )
 | Red_cast : forall (c:castop) (e e':exp),
     lc_castop c ->
     Reduction e e' ->
     Reduction (e_cast c e) (e_cast c e')
 | Red_castelim : forall (A B:typ) (v:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_typ B ->
     value v ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_unfold A)  ( (e_cast (c_fold B) v) ) ) v
 | Red_castid : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     Reduction (e_cast c_id v) v
 | Red_castfix : forall (c:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop (c_fixc c) ->
     value e ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_fixc c) e) (e_cast  (open_castop_wrt_castop  c   (c_fixc c) )  e).

Inductive eqe2 : tctx -> actx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | e2_assump : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A B:typ),
      In ( A ,  B )  H  ->
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     eqe2 D H A B
 | e2_refl : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     eqe2 D H A A
 | e2_trans : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A C B:typ),
     eqe2 D H A B ->
     eqe2 D H B C ->
     eqe2 D H A C
 | e2_symm : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (B A:typ),
     eqe2 D H A B ->
     eqe2 D H B A
 | e2_fld : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
     eqe2 D H (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )
 | e2_arrfix : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     eqe2 D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A1 B1 ->
     eqe2 D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A2 B2 ->
     eqe2 D H (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2).

Inductive ACSubtyping : acctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | ACSub_top : forall (AE:acctx) (A:typ),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberWFT AE A ->
     ACSubtyping AE A t_top
 | ACSub_refl : forall (AE:acctx) (A:typ),
     AmberWF AE ->
     AmberWFT AE A ->
     ACSubtyping AE A A
 | ACSub_trans : forall (AE:acctx) (A C B:typ),
     ACSubtyping AE A B ->
     ACSubtyping AE B C ->
     ACSubtyping AE A C
 | ACSub_var : forall (AE:acctx) (X Y:typevar),
     AmberWF AE ->
      In ( X ,  Y )  AE  ->
     ACSubtyping AE (t_var_f X) (t_var_f Y)
 | ACSub_eq : forall (AE:acctx) (A B:typ),
     AmberWF AE ->
     eqe2  nil   nil  A B ->
     ACSubtyping AE A B
 | ACSub_arrow : forall (AE:acctx) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     ACSubtyping AE B1 A1 ->
     ACSubtyping AE A2 B2 ->
     ACSubtyping AE (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | ACSub_rec : forall (L:vars) (AE:acctx) (A B:typ),
      ( forall Y , Y \notin  L  ->  ( forall X , X \notin   L  \u {{ Y }}  -> ACSubtyping  (cons ( X , Y  )  AE )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ B (t_var_f Y) )  )  )  ->
     ACSubtyping AE (t_mu A) (t_mu B).

Inductive EquiTyping : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | ETyping_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     EquiTyping G (e_lit i) t_int
 | ETyping_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Inductive typ : Set :=
| typ_top   : typ
| typ_nat   : typ
| typ_bvar  : nat -> typ
| typ_fvar  : var -> typ
| typ_mu :    typ -> typ
| typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
.

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint unfoldT (A : typ) X (n : nat) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => open_tt A (typ_fvar X)
  | (S i) => open_tt A (unfoldT A X i)
  end.

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall n X, X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (unfoldT A X n)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom),
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs t e1 => exp_abs t (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  end.

Notation open_ee e1 e2     := (open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1).

Fixpoint subst_ee (y:atom) (u:exp) (e:exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | (exp_bvar n)   => exp_bvar n
  | (exp_fvar x)   => (if x == y then u else (exp_fvar x))
  | (exp_abs T e1)    => exp_abs T (subst_ee y u e1)
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_ee y u e1) (subst_ee y u e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (subst_ee y u e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (subst_ee y u e)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (exp_bvar nat)   => {}
  | (exp_fvar x)   => {{x}}
  | (exp_abs T e)     => fv_exp e
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => fv_exp e1 \u fv_exp e2
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_unfold T e => fv_exp e
  | exp_fold T e => fv_exp e
  end.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_fvar : forall (x:var),
     expr (exp_fvar x)
 | lc_abs : forall (e:exp) L T,
     (forall x, x \notin L -> expr (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)))  ->
     type T ->
     expr (exp_abs T e)
 | lc_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_app e1 e2)
 | lc_nat :
     expr exp_nat
 | lc_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
 | lc_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e).

Inductive Sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| SA_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    Sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| SA_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    Sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| SA_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WFS E A ->
    Sub E A typ_top
| SA_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    Sub E B1 A1 ->
    Sub E A2 B2 ->
    Sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| SA_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall n X,
        X \notin L ->
        Sub ((X ~ bind_sub) ++ E)  (unfoldT A1 X n) (unfoldT A2 X n)) ->
    Sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
| typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
| typing_var : forall (G:env) (x:var) (T:typ),
     wf_env G ->
     binds x (bind_typ T) G  ->
     typing G (exp_fvar x) T
 | typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (T1:typ) (e:exp) (T2:typ),
     (forall x , x \notin L -> typing ((x ~ bind_typ T1) ++ G) (open_ee e x) T2)  ->
     typing G (exp_abs T1 e) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
 | typing_app : forall (G:env) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
     typing G e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
     typing G e2 T1 ->
     typing G (exp_app e1 e2) T2
 | typing_fold : forall G A e ,
     typing G e  (open_tt A  (typ_mu A))    ->
     WFS G (typ_mu A) ->
     typing G (exp_fold (typ_mu A) e) (typ_mu A)
 | typing_unfold : forall G T e,
     typing G e (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold (typ_mu T) e)  (open_tt T  (typ_mu T))
 | typing_sub: forall G T e S ,
     typing G e S ->
     Sub G S T ->
     typing G e T.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e').

Inductive WFA : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFA_top : forall E, WFA E typ_top
| WFA_nat : forall E, WFA E typ_nat
| WFA_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WFA E (typ_fvar X)
| WFA_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFA E A ->
    WFA E B ->
    WFA E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFA_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WFA (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFA E (typ_mu A).

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A (open_tt A X))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 X)) (open_tt A2 (open_tt A2 X))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).

Inductive Mode := Neg | Pos.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Neg => Pos
  | Pos => Neg
  end.

Fixpoint UnfoldS n X A :=
  match n with
  | 0   => A
  | S i => subst_tt X (UnfoldS i X A) A
  end.

Definition chooseD(n : nat) (m : Mode) X (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => subst_tt X (subst_tt X (UnfoldS n X C) C)
  | Neg => subst_tt X (subst_tt X (UnfoldS n X D) D)
  end.

Definition chooseS (m : Mode) X (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => subst_tt X C
  | Neg => subst_tt X D
  end.

Fixpoint def1 (X: atom) (A: typ) (n:nat): typ :=
  match n with
  | 0 => A
  | S n1 => subst_tt X (def1 X A n1) A
  end.

  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint unfoldT (A : typ) X (n : nat) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => open_tt A (typ_fvar X)
  | (S i) => open_tt A (unfoldT A X i)
  end.

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall n X, X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (unfoldT A X n)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom),
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs t e1 => exp_abs t (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  end.

Notation open_ee e1 e2     := (open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1).

Fixpoint subst_ee (y:atom) (u:exp) (e:exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | (exp_bvar n)   => exp_bvar n
  | (exp_fvar x)   => (if x == y then u else (exp_fvar x))
  | (exp_abs T e1)    => exp_abs T (subst_ee y u e1)
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_ee y u e1) (subst_ee y u e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (subst_ee y u e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (subst_ee y u e)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (exp_bvar nat)   => {}
  | (exp_fvar x)   => {{x}}
  | (exp_abs T e)     => fv_exp e
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => fv_exp e1 \u fv_exp e2
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_unfold T e => fv_exp e
  | exp_fold T e => fv_exp e
  end.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_fvar : forall (x:var),
     expr (exp_fvar x)
 | lc_abs : forall (e:exp) L T,
     (forall x, x \notin L -> expr (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)))  ->
     type T ->
     expr (exp_abs T e)
 | lc_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_app e1 e2)
 | lc_nat :
     expr exp_nat
 | lc_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
 | lc_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e).

Inductive Sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| SA_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    Sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| SA_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    Sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| SA_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WFS E A ->
    Sub E A typ_top
| SA_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    Sub E B1 A1 ->
    Sub E A2 B2 ->
    Sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| SA_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall n X,
        X \notin L ->
        Sub ((X ~ bind_sub) ++ E)  (unfoldT A1 X n) (unfoldT A2 X n)) ->
    Sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
| typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
| typing_var : forall (G:env) (x:var) (T:typ),
     wf_env G ->
     binds x (bind_typ T) G  ->
     typing G (exp_fvar x) T
 | typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (T1:typ) (e:exp) (T2:typ),
     (forall x , x \notin L -> typing ((x ~ bind_typ T1) ++ G) (open_ee e x) T2)  ->
     typing G (exp_abs T1 e) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
 | typing_app : forall (G:env) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
     typing G e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
     typing G e2 T1 ->
     typing G (exp_app e1 e2) T2
 | typing_fold : forall G A e ,
     typing G e  (open_tt A  (typ_mu A))    ->
     WFS G (typ_mu A) ->
     typing G (exp_fold (typ_mu A) e) (typ_mu A)
 | typing_unfold : forall G T e,
     typing G e (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold (typ_mu T) e)  (open_tt T  (typ_mu T))
 | typing_sub: forall G T e S ,
     typing G e S ->
     Sub G S T ->
     typing G e T.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e').

Inductive WFA : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFA_top : forall E, WFA E typ_top
| WFA_nat : forall E, WFA E typ_nat
| WFA_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WFA E (typ_fvar X)
| WFA_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFA E A ->
    WFA E B ->
    WFA E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFA_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WFA (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFA E (typ_mu A).

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A (open_tt A X))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 X)) (open_tt A2 (open_tt A2 X))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).

Inductive Mode := Neg | Pos.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Neg => Pos
  | Pos => Neg
  end.

Fixpoint UnfoldS n X A :=
  match n with
  | 0   => A
  | S i => subst_tt X (UnfoldS i X A) A
  end.

Definition chooseD(n : nat) (m : Mode) X (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => subst_tt X (subst_tt X (UnfoldS n X C) C)
  | Neg => subst_tt X (subst_tt X (UnfoldS n X D) D)
  end.

Definition chooseS (m : Mode) X (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => subst_tt X C
  | Neg => subst_tt X D
  end.

Fixpoint def1 (X: atom) (A: typ) (n:nat): typ :=
  match n with
  | 0 => A
  | S n1 => subst_tt X (def1 X A n1) A
  end.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Rules.

Require Export Infra.

Require Export DoubleUnfolding.

Definition env_amber := list (atom * atom).

Fixpoint domA (E : env_amber) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (X,Y)::E' => {{X}} \u {{Y}} \u domA E'
  end.

Inductive wfe_amber: env_amber -> Prop :=
| wfea_base:
    wfe_amber nil
| wfea_cons: forall X Y E,
    X \notin domA E ->
    Y \notin {{X}} \u domA E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wfe_amber ((X,Y)::E).

Inductive wf_amber: env_amber -> typ -> Prop :=
| wfa_nat: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E typ_nat
| wfa_top: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E typ_top
| wfa_fvarl: forall E X Y,
    In (X,Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E X
| wfa_fvarr: forall E X Y,
    In (X,Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E Y
| wfa_arrow: forall E A1 A2,
    wf_amber E A1 ->
    wf_amber E A2 ->
    wf_amber E (typ_arrow A1 A2)
| wfa_rec: forall E A L,
    (forall X Y,
        X \notin L -> Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
        wf_amber (X ~ Y ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
    wf_amber E (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub_amber: env_amber -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam_nat: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam_top: forall E A,
    wf_amber E A ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E A typ_top
| sam_fvar: forall E X Y,
    In (X, Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar Y)
| sam_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X Y,
        X \notin L -> Y \notin {{X}} \u L ->
        sub_amber ((X,Y)::E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B Y)) ->
    sub_amber E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
| sam_refl: forall E A,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E (typ_mu A) ->
    sub_amber E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu A)
.

Inductive posvar: Mode -> atom -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| pos_nat: forall X m,
    posvar m X typ_nat typ_nat
| pos_top: forall X A m,
    type A ->
    posvar m X A typ_top
| pos_top_flip: forall X A m,
    type A ->
    posvar m X typ_top A
| pos_fvar_x: forall X,
    posvar Pos X (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| pos_fvar_y: forall X Y m,
    X <> Y ->
    posvar m X (typ_fvar Y) (typ_fvar Y)
| pos_arrow: forall X m A1 A2 B1 B2,
    posvar (flip m) X B1 A1 ->
    posvar m X A2 B2 ->
    posvar m X (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| pos_rec: forall X m A B L,
    (forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
               posvar m X (open_tt A Y) (open_tt B Y)) ->
     (forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
               posvar Pos Y (open_tt A Y) (open_tt B Y)) ->
    posvar m X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
| pos_rec_t : forall A X m L,
    X \notin fv_tt A ->
    (forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
               type (open_tt A Y)) ->
    posvar m X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFA E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X ,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Fixpoint env_trans (E : env_amber) : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (X,Y)::E' => X ~ bind_sub ++  env_trans E'
  end.

Fixpoint rename_env (E : env_amber) (A : typ) : typ :=
  match E with
  | nil => A
  | cons (X,Y) E' => subst_tt Y (typ_fvar X) (rename_env E' A)
  end.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Rules.

Require Export Infra.

Require Export AmberBase.

Require Import Lia.

Inductive WFC :  typ -> nat -> Prop :=
| WC_nat: forall k,
    WFC typ_nat k
| WF_top: forall k,
    WFC typ_top k
| WF_fvar: forall X k,
    WFC (typ_fvar X) k
| WF_bvar: forall b k,
    b < k ->
    WFC (typ_bvar b) k
| WF_arrow: forall A B k,
    WFC A k ->
    WFC B k ->
    WFC (typ_arrow A B) k
| WF_rec: forall A n,
    WFC A (S n) ->
    WFC (typ_mu A) n
.

Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X      => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Definition close_tt T X := close_tt_rec 0 X T.

Fixpoint weight (T:typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + weight A + weight B
  | typ_mu A => 1 + weight A
  end.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export AmberBase.

Fixpoint mode_xor (m1 m2 : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m1 with
  | Pos => match m2 with
           | Pos => Pos
           | Neg => Neg
           end
  | Neg => match m2 with
           | Pos => Neg
           | Neg => Pos
           end
  end.

Inductive typePairR : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| tp_nat:
    typePairR  typ_nat typ_nat
| tp_top: forall  A ,
    type A ->
    typePairR  A typ_top
| tp_top_flip: forall A ,
    type A ->
    typePairR  typ_top A
| tp_fvar_x: forall X,
    typePairR (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| tp_arrow: forall  A1 A2 B1 B2,
    typePairR  B1 A1 ->
    typePairR  A2 B2 ->
    typePairR  (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| tp_rec: forall  A B L,
    (forall X, X \notin L ->
               typePairR (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    typePairR (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B).
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export AmberSoundness.

Require Export PositiveSubtyping.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Inductive monotone: env -> typ -> typ -> env_mode -> Prop :=
| M_base: forall A B,
    monotone nil A B nil
| M_neg: forall A B E  EM  X ,
    monotone E A B EM ->
    posvar Neg X A B ->
    monotone (X~bind_sub ++ E) A B  ( Neg::EM)
| M_pos: forall A B E  EM  X ,
    monotone E A B  EM ->
    posvar Pos X A B ->
    monotone (X~bind_sub ++ E) A B  ( Pos::EM)
.

Fixpoint domL (E : env_amber) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (X,Y)::E' => add X (domL E')
  end.

Fixpoint domR (E : env_amber) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (X,Y)::E' => add Y (domR E')
  end.

Fixpoint domS (E : list atom) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | Y::E' => add Y (domS E')
  end.

Inductive env_copy:  env ->  list atom -> atoms -> Prop :=
| EC_base: forall A,
    env_copy  nil  nil A
| EC_cons1: forall  X EX Y EY m Z A,
    env_copy  EX  EY A ->
    X \notin dom EX ->
    X \in domS EY ->
    Y \notin domS EY \u {{X}} \u dom EX \u A ->
    Z \notin domS EY \u {{Y}} \u {{X}} \u dom EX \u A ->
    env_copy (X~m ++ EX)  (Z :: Y :: EY) A
| EC_cons2: forall  X EX Y EY m A,
    env_copy  EX  EY A ->
    X \notin dom EX \u domS EY->
    Y \notin domS EY \u {{X}} \u dom EX \u A ->
    env_copy (X~m ++ EX)  (X :: Y :: EY) A.

Definition minus A B := forall X, X \in A -> X \notin B.

Inductive env_conv:  env -> env_amber -> Prop :=
| EV_base:
    env_conv  nil  nil
| EV_cons: forall  X EX Y EY m ,
    env_conv EX EY ->
    env_conv (X~m ++ EX) ((X,Y)::EY).

Inductive distinct:  list atom -> Prop :=
| DT_base:
    distinct nil
| DT_cons: forall  X E ,
    distinct E ->
    X \notin domS E ->
    distinct (X::E).

Fixpoint filter_env (E:env) (G:list atom) : list atom :=
  match E with
  | nil => G
  | (X,_)::E' => filter_env E' (List.remove eq_dec X G)
  end.

Fixpoint domE (E:env) : list atom :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (X,m)::E' => X::(domE E')
  end.

Definition disjoint (E:atoms) (G:atoms) :=
  forall X, (X \in E -> X \notin G) /\ (X \in G -> X \notin E).

Definition flipEx (A : option Mode) : option Mode :=
  match A with
  | Some x => Some (flip x)
  | None => None
  end.

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Definition eqM (a: option Mode) (b: Mode) : bool :=
  match a with
  | None => false
  | Some a' => eqMode a' b
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

Fixpoint isBindsub (E:env) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | nil => True
  | (a,bind_sub)::E' => isBindsub E'
  | _ => False
  end.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export AmberSoundness.

Require Export DoubleUnfolding.

Inductive wk_sub: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| W_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    wk_sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| W_top: forall E A,
    WFA E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    wk_sub E A typ_top
| W_fvar: forall E X ,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    wf_env E ->
    wk_sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| W_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    wk_sub E B1 A1 ->

Definition env_amber := list (atom * atom).

Fixpoint domA (E : env_amber) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (X,Y)::E' => {{X}} \u {{Y}} \u domA E'
  end.

Inductive wfe_amber: env_amber -> Prop :=
| wfea_base:
    wfe_amber nil
| wfea_cons: forall X Y E,
    X \notin domA E ->
    Y \notin {{X}} \u domA E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wfe_amber ((X,Y)::E).

Inductive wf_amber: env_amber -> typ -> Prop :=
| wfa_nat: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E typ_nat
| wfa_top: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E typ_top
| wfa_fvarl: forall E X Y,
    In (X,Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E X
| wfa_fvarr: forall E X Y,
    In (X,Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E Y
| wfa_arrow: forall E A1 A2,
    wf_amber E A1 ->
    wf_amber E A2 ->
    wf_amber E (typ_arrow A1 A2)
| wfa_rec: forall E A L,
    (forall X Y,
        X \notin L -> Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
        wf_amber (X ~ Y ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
    wf_amber E (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub_amber: env_amber -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam_nat: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam_top: forall E A,
    wf_amber E A ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E A typ_top
| sam_fvar: forall E X Y,
    In (X, Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar Y)
| sam_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X Y,
        X \notin L -> Y \notin {{X}} \u L ->
        sub_amber ((X,Y)::E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B Y)) ->
    sub_amber E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
| sam_refl: forall E A,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E (typ_mu A) ->
    sub_amber E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu A)
.

Inductive posvar: Mode -> atom -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| pos_nat: forall X m,
    posvar m X typ_nat typ_nat
| pos_top: forall X A m,
    type A ->
    posvar m X A typ_top
| pos_top_flip: forall X A m,

    X <> Y ->
    posvar m X (typ_fvar Y) (typ_fvar Y)

    posvar (flip m) X B1 A1 ->
    posvar m X A2 B2 ->
    posvar m X (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| pos_rec: forall X m A B L,
    (forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
               posvar m X (open_tt A Y) (open_tt B Y)) ->
     (forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
               posvar Pos Y (open_tt A Y) (open_tt B Y)) ->
    posvar m X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
| pos_rec_t : forall A X m L,
    X \notin fv_tt A ->
    (forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
               type (open_tt A Y)) ->
    posvar m X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,

Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X      => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Definition close_tt T X := close_tt_rec 0 X T.

Fixpoint weight (T:typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1

    monotone E A B EM ->
    posvar Neg X A B ->

  end.

    env_copy  nil  nil A

    env_copy  EX  EY A ->
    X \notin dom EX ->
    X \in domS EY ->
    Y \notin domS EY \u {{X}} \u dom EX \u A ->
    Z \notin domS EY \u {{Y}} \u {{X}} \u dom EX \u A ->
    env_copy (X~m ++ EX)  (Z :: Y :: EY) A
| EC_cons2: forall  X EX Y EY m A,
    env_copy  EX  EY A ->
    X \notin dom EX \u domS EY->
    Y \notin domS EY \u {{X}} \u dom EX \u A ->
    env_copy (X~m ++ EX)  (X :: Y :: EY) A.

Definition minus A B := forall X, X \in A -> X \notin B.

Inductive env_conv:  env -> env_amber -> Prop :=

    env_conv  nil  nil
| EV_cons: forall  X EX Y EY m ,

    distinct E ->
    X \notin domS E ->

  end.

  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true

  end.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Section 1: basic atom equality and type substitution lemmas  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma eq_dec_same : forall (X:atom) (A B:Type) (a:A) (b:B),
  (if (eq_dec X X) then a else b) = a.
Proof. intros. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma eq_dec_diff : forall (X Y:atom) (A B:Type) (a:A) (b:B),
  X <> Y -> (if (eq_dec X Y) then a else b) = b.
Proof. intros X Y A B a b Hne. destruct (eq_dec X Y) as [e|n]. exfalso; auto. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_same : forall (P:typ) (X:typevar),
  typsubst_typ P X (t_var_f X) = P.
Proof. intros. simpl. apply eq_dec_same. Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_diff : forall (P:typ) (X Y:typevar),
  X <> Y -> typsubst_typ P X (t_var_f Y) = t_var_f Y.
Proof. intros. simpl. apply eq_dec_diff. auto. Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_open_rec : forall (A:typ) (k:nat) (B:typ) (P:typ) (X:typevar),
  typsubst_typ P X (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k B A) =
  open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k (typsubst_typ P X B) (typsubst_typ P X A).
Proof.
  induction A; intros; simpl; auto.
  - (* t_var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[l|e]|r]; auto.
  - (* t_mu *) rewrite IHA. auto.
Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_open : forall (A B:typ) (P:typ) (X:typevar),
  typsubst_typ P X (open_typ_wrt_typ A B) =
  open_typ_wrt_typ (typsubst_typ P X A) (typsubst_typ P X B).
Proof. intros. unfold open_typ_wrt_typ. apply typsubst_typ_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_id : forall (A:typ) (P:typ) (X:typevar),
  X \notin typefv_typ A -> typsubst_typ P X A = A.
Proof.
  induction A; intros; simpl in *; auto.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (eq_dec a X) as [e|n]; auto.
    exfalso. apply H. rewrite e. fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) rewrite IHA1, IHA2; auto.
  - (* mu *) rewrite IHA; auto.
Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_open_self : forall (A:typ) (P:typ) (X:typevar),
  X \notin typefv_typ A ->
  typsubst_typ P X (open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X)) = open_typ_wrt_typ A P.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite typsubst_typ_open.
  rewrite typsubst_typ_id; auto. rewrite typsubst_typ_same. auto.
Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_comm : forall (A:typ) (P Q:typ) (X Y:typevar),
  X <> Y -> X \notin typefv_typ Q -> Y \notin typefv_typ P ->
  typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y A) = typsubst_typ Q Y (typsubst_typ P X A).
Proof.
  induction A; intros; simpl; auto.
  - (* fvar *)
    repeat match goal with
    | |- context [eq_dec ?x ?y] => destruct (eq_dec x y)
    end; auto; try congruence.
    + subst. rewrite typsubst_typ_id; auto.
    + subst. rewrite typsubst_typ_diff; auto.
    + rewrite typsubst_typ_diff; auto.
    + rewrite typsubst_typ_id; auto.
    + subst. exfalso; auto.
    + subst. rewrite typsubst_typ_diff; auto.
  - (* arrow *) rewrite IHA1, IHA2; auto.
  - (* mu *) rewrite IHA; auto.
Qed.

Lemma typsubst_typ_notin : forall (A:typ) (P:typ) (X Y:typevar),
  X \notin typefv_typ A -> typsubst_typ P Y A = A \/
  (exists A', A = t_var_f X /\ False).
Proof.
  intros A P X Y H. left. apply typsubst_typ_id. auto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (T:typ), Typing G e T ->
  forall (x:termvar) (A:typ), WFTmE (cons (x,A) G) -> Typing (cons (x,A) G) e T.
Proof.
  intros G e T H. induction H as [G i Hwf|G z C Hwf Hb|L G A1 e A2 Hprem IH|G e1 e2 A2 A1 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|G c e B A H IH TC|G e B A H IH AS].
  - (* int *) intros x0 A0 Hwf'. apply Typing_int. auto.
  - (* var *) intros x0 A0 Hwf'. apply Typing_var; auto.
  - (* abs *) intros x0 A0 Hwf'.
    apply Typing_abs with (L := L \u {{x0}} \u dom G).
    intros y Hy.
    assert (HyL : y \notin L) by (simpl in Hy; fsetdec).
    assert (Hyx : y <> x0) by (intro; subst; simpl in Hy; fsetdec).
    assert (HyG : y \notin dom G) by (simpl in Hy; fsetdec).
    assert (Hwf_y : WFTmE (cons (x0,A0) (cons (y,A1) G))).
    { apply WFTmE_cons.
      - apply (typing_wftmE (cons (y,A1) G) (open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f y)) A2).
        apply (Hprem y HyL).
      - apply (proj2 (WFTmE_cons_inv G x0 A0 Hwf')).
      - simpl. apply notin_add_3.
        + auto.
        + apply (WFTmE_cons_notin G x0 A0 Hwf'). }
    apply (typing_swap_prefix (cons (x0,A0) (cons (y,A1) G)) (open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f y)) A2
           (IH y HyL x0 A0 Hwf_y) nil x0 A0 y A1 G).
    + auto.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* app *) intros x0 A0 Hwf'. apply Typing_app with (A1 := A1); auto.
  - (* cast *) intros x0 A0 Hwf'. apply Typing_cast with (A := A); auto.
  - (* sub *) intros x0 A0 Hwf'. apply Typing_sub with (A := A); auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint freshA (Z:atom) (E:acctx) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | nil => True
  | (a,b) :: E' => Z <> a /\ Z <> b /\ freshA Z E'
  end.

Lemma in_singleton_iff : forall (x y:atom), x \in singleton y <-> x = y.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1.
  - intro e. subst. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_union_iff : forall (x:atom) (s s':atoms),
  x \notin union s s' <-> x \notin s /\ x \notin s'.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - intro H. split; intro Hin; apply H; [apply AtomSetImpl.union_2 | apply AtomSetImpl.union_3]; auto.
  - intros [H1 H2] Hin. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin]; [apply H1|apply H2]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_domA_freshA : forall (E:acctx) (Z:atom), Z \notin domA E <-> freshA Z E.
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma freshA_app : forall (P Q:acctx) (Z:atom),
  freshA Z (P ++ Q) <-> freshA Z P /\ freshA Z Q.
Proof.
  intros P. induction P as [|p P IH].
  - intros. simpl. tauto.
  - intros Q Z. destruct p as [a b]. simpl. rewrite IH. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma freshA_cons : forall (a b Z:atom) (E:acctx),
  freshA Z ((a,b)::E) <-> Z <> a /\ Z <> b /\ freshA Z E.
Proof. intros. simpl. tauto. Qed.

Lemma amber_wf_drop : forall (X Y:atom) (AE:acctx), AmberWF (cons (X,Y) AE) -> AmberWF AE.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.

Lemma notin_union_iff : forall (x:atom) (s s':atoms),
  x \notin union s s' <-> x \notin s /\ x \notin s'.

  - intro H. split; intro Hin; apply H; [apply AtomSetImpl.union_2 | apply AtomSetImpl.union_3]; auto.
  - intros [H1 H2] Hin. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hin.

Lemma notin_domA_freshA : forall (E:acctx) (Z:atom), Z \notin domA E <-> freshA Z E.
Proof.

  - intro Z. destruct p as [a b]. simpl.
    rewrite notin_union_iff. rewrite notin_union_iff. rewrite in_singleton_iff. rewrite in_singleton_iff.

  - intros Q Z. destruct p as [a b]. simpl. rewrite IH. tauto.

Proof. intros. split; intro H; fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma notin_union_iff : forall (x:atom) (s s':atoms),

Lemma amber_wft_subst : forall (AE:acctx) (X Y:atom) (P Q:typ) (A:typ),
  X <> Y -> freshA X AE -> freshA Y AE ->
  AmberWFT AE P -> AmberWFT AE Q ->
  AmberWFT (cons (X,Y) AE) A ->
  AmberWFT AE (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y A)).
Proof.
  intros AE X Y P Q A HXY HX HY HP HQ Hwt.
  remember (cons (X,Y) AE) as E eqn:EE.

  induction Hwt as [E0 Hwf|E0 Hwf|E0 Z W Hwf Hin|E0 W Z Hwf Hin|E0 A1 A2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|L E0 A0 Y0 Hprem IHprem];

  - (* varl *) destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst Z W.

      { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HXY; symmetry; auto. }
      rewrite E1. rewrite typsubst_typ_same. auto.
    + assert (HZX : Z <> X).
      { intro e. subst Z. apply (proj2 (notin_domA_freshA AE X)) in HX.
        apply HX. apply (domA_in_l AE X W). auto. }
      assert (HZY : Z <> Y).
      { intro e. subst Z. apply (proj2 (notin_domA_freshA AE Y)) in HY.
        apply HY. apply (domA_in_l AE Y W). auto. }
      assert (E1 : typsubst_typ Q Y (t_var_f Z) = t_var_f Z).
      { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HZY; symmetry; auto. }
      assert (E2 : typsubst_typ P X (t_var_f Z) = t_var_f Z).
      { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HZX; symmetry; auto. }
      rewrite E1, E2. apply AWFT_varl with (Y:=W).
      * apply amber_wf_drop in Hwf. auto.
      * auto.
  - (* varr *) destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst Z W.
      assert (E1 : typsubst_typ Q Y (t_var_f Y) = Q) by apply typsubst_typ_same.
      rewrite E1. apply amber_wft_subst1 with (X:=X) (P:=P); auto.
    + assert (HWX : W <> X).
      { intro e. subst W. apply (proj2 (notin_domA_freshA AE X)) in HX.
        apply HX. apply (domA_in_r AE Z X). auto. }
      assert (HWY : W <> Y).
      { intro e. subst W. apply (proj2 (notin_domA_freshA AE Y)) in HY.
        apply HY. apply (domA_in_r AE Z Y). auto. }
      assert (E1 : typsubst_typ Q Y (t_var_f W) = t_var_f W).
      { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HWY; symmetry; auto. }
      assert (E2 : typsubst_typ P X (t_var_f W) = t_var_f W).
      { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HWX; symmetry; auto. }
      rewrite E1, E2. apply AWFT_varr with (X:=Z).
      * apply amber_wf_drop in Hwf. auto.
      * auto.
  - (* arrow *) apply AWFT_arrow.
    + apply (IH1 AE X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ eq_refl).
    + apply (IH2 AE X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ eq_refl).
  - (* rec *) apply (AWFT_rec (L \u singleton X \u singleton Y \u domA AE) AE A0 Y0).

    assert (HX'X : X' <> X) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).

    assert (HX'E : freshA X' AE) by (apply (proj1 (notin_domA_freshA AE X')); simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
    assert (HY'L : Y' \notin L \u singleton X') by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
    assert (HY'X : Y' <> X) by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
    assert (HY'Y : Y' <> Y) by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
    assert (HY'E : freshA Y' AE) by (apply (proj1 (notin_domA_freshA AE Y')); simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
    assert (HX'Y' : X' <> Y') by (intro; subst; simpl in HY'; fsetdec).

    assert (HfY : freshA Y ((X',Y')::AE)).

    assert (HwfQ : AmberWFT ((X',Y')::AE) Q) by (apply amber_wft_weaken_front; auto).
    assert (HpermW : AmberWFT ((X,Y)::(X',Y')::AE) (open_typ_wrt_typ A0 (t_var_f X'))).
    { apply (amber_wft_perm ((X',Y')::(X,Y)::AE) (open_typ_wrt_typ A0 (t_var_f X'))).
      - apply (Hprem X' HX'L Y' HY'L).
      - apply perm_swap. }

    assert (HlcP : lc_typ P) by (apply (AmberWFT_lc_typ AE P); auto).
    assert (HlcQ : lc_typ Q) by (apply (AmberWFT_lc_typ AE Q); auto).

    assert (HYdfv : Yd \notin typefv_typ A0) by fsetdec.
    assert (HYdX : Yd <> X) by fsetdec.
    assert (HYdY : Yd <> Y) by fsetdec.

                  (fun e => HneX'X (eq_sym e)) (fun e => HneX'Y (eq_sym e))) as Hcomm.

213	    inversion H; subst.
214	    apply AWF_cons.
215	    + apply (IH E X Y). auto.
216	    + intro Hin. apply H4. apply (domA_mid_in P0 E X Y a); auto.
217	    + intro Hin. apply H5. apply (domA_mid_in P0 E X Y b); auto.
218	    + auto.

221	Lemma amber_wft_subst : forall (P0 E:acctx) (X Y:atom) (P Q:typ) (A:typ),
222	  X <> Y -> freshA X (P0++E) -> freshA Y (P0++E) ->
223	  AmberWFT (P0++E) P -> AmberWFT (P0++E) Q ->
224	  AmberWFT (P0 ++ cons (X,Y) E) A ->
225	  AmberWFT (P0++E) (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y A)).
226	Proof.
227	  intros P0 E X Y P Q A HXY HX HY HP HQ Hwt.
228	  remember (P0 ++ cons (X,Y) E) as C eqn:EC.
229	  revert P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ EC.
230	  induction Hwt as [C0 Hwf|C0 Hwf|C0 Z W Hwf Hin|C0 W Z Hwf Hin|C0 A1 A2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|L C0 A0 Y0 Hprem IHprem];
231	  intros P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ EC; subst C0.
232	  - (* nat *) apply AWFT_nat. apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
233	  - (* top *) apply AWFT_top. apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
234	  - (* varl *)
235	    apply in_app_iff in Hin. destruct Hin as [HinP0|Hin].
236	    + apply AWFT_varl with (Y:=W).
237	      * apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
238	      * apply in_or_app. left. auto.
239	    + simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|HinE].
240	      * inversion Heq. subst Z W.
241	        assert (E1 : typsubst_typ Q Y (t_var_f X) = t_var_f X).
242	        { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HXY; symmetry; auto. }
243	        rewrite E1. rewrite typsubst_typ_same. auto.
244	      * apply AWFT_varl with (Y:=W).
245	        -- apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
246	        -- apply in_or_app. right. auto.
247	  - (* varr *)
248	    apply in_app_iff in Hin. destruct Hin as [HinP0|Hin].
249	    + apply AWFT_varr with (X:=Z).
250	      * apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
251	      * apply in_or_app. left. auto.
252	    + simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|HinE].
253	      * inversion Heq. subst Z W.
254	        assert (E1 : typsubst_typ Q Y (t_var_f Y) = Q) by apply typsubst_typ_same.
255	        rewrite E1. apply amber_wft_subst1 with (X:=X) (P:=P); auto.
256	      * apply AWFT_varr with (X:=Z).
257	        -- apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
258	        -- apply in_or_app. right. auto.
259	  - (* arrow *) apply AWFT_arrow.
260	    + apply (IH1 P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ eq_refl).
261	    + apply (IH2 P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ eq_refl).
262	  - (* rec *) apply (AWFT_rec (L \u singleton X \u singleton Y \u domA (P0++E)) (P0++E) (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y A0)) Y0).
263	    intros X' HX' Y' HY'.
264	    assert (HX'L : X' \notin L) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
265	    assert (HX'X : X' <> X) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
266	    assert (HX'Y : X' <> Y) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
267	    assert (HX'E : freshA X' (P0++E)) by (apply (proj1 (notin_domA_freshA (P0++E) X')); simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
268	    assert (HY'L : Y' \notin L \u singleton X') by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
269	    assert (HY'X : Y' <> X) by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
270	    assert (HY'Y : Y' <> Y) by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
271	    assert (HY'E : freshA Y' (P0++E)) by (apply (proj1 (notin_domA_freshA (P0++E) Y')); simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
272	    assert (HX'Y' : X' <> Y') by (intro; subst; simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
273	    assert (HfX : freshA X ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E)).
274	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. rewrite freshA_app. rewrite freshA_cons. split; [|split]; auto. }
275	    assert (HfY : freshA Y ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E)).
276	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. rewrite freshA_app. rewrite freshA_cons. split; [|split]; auto. }
277	    assert (HwfP : AmberWFT ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E) P).
278	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. apply amber_wft_weaken_front with (Z:=X') (W:=Y'); auto. }
279	    assert (HwfQ : AmberWFT ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E) Q).
280	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. apply amber_wft_weaken_front with (Z:=X') (W:=Y'); auto. }
281	    assert (Hres := IHprem X' HX'L Y' HY'L (cons (X',Y') P0) E X Y P Q HXY HfX HfY HwfP HwfQ eq_refl).
282	    assert (HlcP : lc_typ P) by (apply (AmberWFT_lc_typ (P0++E) P); auto).
283	    assert (HlcQ : lc_typ Q) by (apply (AmberWFT_lc_typ (P0++E) Q); auto).
284	    pick fresh Yd for (typefv_typ A0 \u {{X}} \u {{Y}} \u {{X'}}).
285	    assert (HYdfv : Yd \notin typefv_typ A0) by fsetdec.
286	    assert (HYdX : Yd <> X) by fsetdec.
287	    assert (HYdY : Yd <> Y) by fsetdec.
288	    assert (HYdX' : Yd <> X') by fsetdec.
289	    assert (HXd : X' <> Yd) by auto.
290	    assert (HneX'Y : X' <> Y) by auto.
291	    assert (HneX'X : X' <> X) by auto.
292	    pose proof (typsubst_open_gen A0 0 P Q X Y X' HlcP HlcQ HXY
293	                  (fun e => HneX'X (eq_sym e)) (fun e => HneX'Y (eq_sym e))) as Hcomm.
294	    exact (eq_ind _ (fun t => AmberWFT ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E) t) Hres _ (eq_sym Hcomm)).
295	Qed.

297	Lemma amber_sub_wft : forall (AE:acctx) (A B:typ),
298	  AmberSubtyping AE A B -> AmberWFT AE A /\ AmberWFT AE B.
299	Proof.
300	  intros AE A B H. induction H as [AE Hwf|AE A Hwf Hwft|AE A1 A2 B1 B2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|AE X Y Hwf Hin|L AE A B Hprem IHprem|AE A Hwf Hwft].
301	  - split; apply AWFT_nat; auto.
302	  - split; auto. apply AWFT_top. auto.
303	  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
304	    split; apply AWFT_arrow; auto.
305	  - split.
306	    + apply AWFT_varl with (Y:=Y); auto.
307	    + apply AWFT_varr with (X:=X); auto.
308	  - split.
309	    + apply (AWFT_rec L AE A Y).
310	      intros X HX Y' HY'.
311	      apply (IHprem Y' HY' X HX).
312	    + apply (AWFT_rec L AE B Y).
313	      intros X HX Y' HY'.
314	      apply (IHprem Y' HY' X HX).
315	  - split; auto.
316	Qed.

326	Lemma amber_sub_perm : forall (AE1 AE2:acctx), Permutation AE1 AE2 ->
327	  forall (A B:typ), AmberSubtyping AE1 A B -> AmberSubtyping AE2 A B.
328	Proof.
329	  intros AE1 AE2 Hp A B H. revert AE2 Hp.
330	  induction H as [AE Hwf|AE A0 Hwf Hwft|AE A1 A2 B1 B2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|AE X Y Hwf Hin|L AE A B Hprem IHprem|AE A0 Hwf Hwft];
331	  intros AE2 Hp.
332	  - apply ASub_nat. apply (amber_wf_perm AE AE2 Hp Hwf).
333	  - apply ASub_top.
334	    + apply (amber_wf_perm AE AE2 Hp Hwf).
335	    + apply (amber_wft_perm AE A0 AE2 Hp Hwft).

337	    + apply (IH1 AE2 Hp).
338	    + apply (IH2 AE2 Hp).

340	    + apply (amber_wf_perm AE AE2 Hp Hwf).
341	    + apply (perm_in (atom*atom) AE AE2 (X,Y) Hp). auto.
342	  - apply (ASub_rec L AE2 A B).
343	    intros Y HY X HX.
344	    apply (IHprem Y HY X HX (cons (X,Y) AE2)).
345	    apply perm_skip. auto.
346	  - apply ASub_self.
347	    + apply (amber_wf_perm AE AE2 Hp Hwf).
348	    + apply (amber_wft_perm AE (t_mu A0) AE2 Hp Hwft).

351	Lemma amber_sub_weaken : forall (AE:acctx) (A B:typ),
352	  AmberSubtyping AE A B -> forall (Z W:atom),
353	  freshA Z AE -> freshA W AE -> Z <> W -> AmberSubtyping (cons (Z,W) AE) A B.
354	Proof.
355	  intros AE A B H. induction H as [AE Hwf|AE A0 Hwf Hwft|AE A1 A2 B1 B2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|AE X Y Hwf Hin|L AE A B Hprem IHprem|AE A0 Hwf Hwft];
356	  intros Z W HZ HW HZW.

365	    + apply amber_wf_weaken_front; auto.
366	    + simpl. auto.

370	    assert (HYX : Y \notin L \u {{X}}) by (simpl in HY; fsetdec).
371	    assert (HYZ : Y <> Z) by (simpl in HY; fsetdec).
372	    assert (HYW : Y <> W) by (simpl in HY; fsetdec).
373	    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by (simpl in HX; fsetdec).
374	    assert (HXZ : X <> Z) by (simpl in HX; fsetdec).
375	    assert (HXW : X <> W) by (simpl in HX; fsetdec).
376	    assert (HfZ : freshA Z ((X,Y)::AE)).
377	    { rewrite freshA_cons. split; [|split]; auto. }
378	    assert (HfW : freshA W ((X,Y)::AE)).
379	    { rewrite freshA_cons. split; [|split]; auto. }
380	    pose proof (IHprem Y HYL X HYX Z W HfZ HfW HZW) as Hres.
381	    apply (amber_sub_perm (cons (Z,W) (cons (X,Y) AE)) (cons (X,Y) (cons (Z,W) AE))).
382	    + apply perm_swap.
383	    + exact Hres.

389	Lemma amber_subst : forall (P0 E:acctx) (X Y:atom) (P Q:typ) (A B:typ),
390	  X <> Y -> freshA X (P0++E) -> freshA Y (P0++E) ->
391	  AmberWFT (P0++E) P -> AmberWFT (P0++E) Q -> AmberSubtyping (P0++E) P Q ->
392	  AmberSubtyping (P0 ++ cons (X,Y) E) A B ->
393	  AmberSubtyping (P0++E) (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y A))
394	                   (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y B)).
395	Proof.

397	  remember (P0 ++ cons (X,Y) E) as C eqn:EC.
398	  revert P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ HPQ EC.
399	  induction Hsub as [C0 Hwf|C0 A0 Hwf Hwft|C0 A1 A2 B1 B2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|C0 Z W Hwf Hin|L C0 A0 B0 Hprem IHprem|C0 A0 Hwf Hwft];
400	  intros P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ HPQ EC; subst C0.

402	  - (* top *) apply ASub_top.
403	    + apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
404	    + apply (amber_wft_subst P0 E X Y P Q A0); auto.
405	  - (* arrow *) apply ASub_arrow.
406	    + apply (IH1 P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ HPQ eq_refl).
407	    + apply (IH2 P0 E X Y P Q HXY HX HY HP HQ HPQ eq_refl).

410	    + apply ASub_var.
411	      * apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
412	      * apply in_or_app. left. auto.
413	    + simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|HinE].
414	      * inversion Heq. subst Z W.
415	        assert (E1 : typsubst_typ Q Y (t_var_f X) = t_var_f X).
416	        { apply typsubst_typ_diff. intro e; apply HXY; symmetry; auto. }
417	        assert (E2 : typsubst_typ P X (t_var_f X) = P) by apply typsubst_typ_same.

420	        { rewrite typsubst_typ_same. auto. }
421	        rewrite E3. auto.
422	      * apply ASub_var.
423	        -- apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
424	        -- apply in_or_app. right. auto.
425	  - (* rec *) apply (ASub_rec (L \u singleton X \u singleton Y \u domA (P0++E)) (P0++E) A0 B0).
426	    intros X' HX' Y' HY'.
427	    assert (HX'L : X' \notin L) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
428	    assert (HX'X : X' <> X) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
429	    assert (HX'Y : X' <> Y) by (simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
430	    assert (HX'E : freshA X' (P0++E)) by (apply (proj1 (notin_domA_freshA (P0++E) X')); simpl in HX'; fsetdec).
431	    assert (HY'L : Y' \notin L \u singleton X') by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
432	    assert (HY'X : Y' <> X) by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
433	    assert (HY'Y : Y' <> Y) by (simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
434	    assert (HY'E : freshA Y' (P0++E)) by (apply (proj1 (notin_domA_freshA (P0++E) Y')); simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
435	    assert (HX'Y' : X' <> Y') by (intro; subst; simpl in HY'; fsetdec).
436	    assert (HfX : freshA X ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E)).
437	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. rewrite freshA_app. rewrite freshA_cons. split; [|split]; auto. }
438	    assert (HfY : freshA Y ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E)).
439	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. rewrite freshA_app. rewrite freshA_cons. split; [|split]; auto. }
440	    assert (HwfP : AmberWFT ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E) P).
441	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. apply amber_wft_weaken_front with (Z:=X') (W:=Y'); auto. }
442	    assert (HwfQ : AmberWFT ((cons (X',Y') P0)++E) Q).
443	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. apply amber_wft_weaken_front with (Z:=X') (W:=Y'); auto. }

445	    { rewrite app_comm_cons. apply amber_sub_weaken with (Z:=X') (W:=Y'); auto. }
446	    assert (Hres := IHprem X' HX'L Y' HY'L (cons (X',Y') P0) E X Y P Q HXY HfX HfY HwfP HwfQ HsubPQ eq_refl).
447	    assert (HlcP : lc_typ P) by (apply (AmberWFT_lc_typ (P0++E) P); auto).

455	    assert (HXd : X' <> Yd) by auto.
456	    assert (HneX'X : X' <> X) by auto.
457	    assert (HneX'Y : X' <> Y) by auto.
458	    assert (HneY'X : Y' <> X) by auto.
459	    assert (HneY'Y : Y' <> Y) by auto.
460	    assert (HcommA : typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y (open_typ_wrt_typ A0 (t_var_f X')))
461	                     = open_typ_wrt_typ (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y A0)) (t_var_f X')).
462	    { pose proof (typsubst_open_gen A0 0 P Q X Y X' HlcP HlcQ HXY
463	                    (fun e => HneX'X (eq_sym e)) (fun e => HneX'Y (eq_sym e))) as Hc.
464	      exact Hc. }
465	    assert (HcommB : typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y (open_typ_wrt_typ B0 (t_var_f Y')))
466	                     = open_typ_wrt_typ (typsubst_typ P X (typsubst_typ Q Y B0)) (t_var_f Y')).
467	    { pose proof (typsubst_open_gen B0 0 P Q X Y Y' HlcP HlcQ HXY
468	                    (fun e => HneY'X (eq_sym e)) (fun e => HneY'Y (eq_sym e))) as Hc.
469	      exact Hc. }
470	    rewrite HcommA in Hres. rewrite HcommB in Hres.
471	    exact Hres.
472	  - (* self *) apply ASub_self.
473	    + apply amber_wf_mid_remove with (X:=X) (Y:=Y). auto.
474	    + apply (amber_wft_subst P0 E X Y P Q (t_mu A0)); auto.
475	Qed.
